Jordan / procurement team —

Thanks for the time last week. Attached is the initial private plan term sheet for HelixHealth (Redwood_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v1.docx). A few asks to keep things moving:

- Please confirm the desired data residency region (you mentioned "East US 2" on the call). We need explicit region language for the Azure private plan exhibit.
- Confirm invoice routing (PO number / billing contact + tax forms) and whether you require Net-45 or Net-60 terms.
- Any mandatory security exhibits beyond SOC 2 Type II? If so, attach the evidence or indicate who in legal owns that.

Would appreciate redlines back by EOD Thursday (1/21) so we can coordinate with legal and Azure marketplace onboarding.

Thanks —
Hannah

Subject: Re: HelixHealth private plan - initial term sheet and residency questions

Hi Hannah —

Thanks. We reviewed the draft and attached our redlines (Helix_Redlines_v1.docx). Key commercial points:

- Data residency: Helix requires all processing and logs to remain in Azure East US 2 (no cross-border replication without prior consent).
- Retention: we typically request 365 days for audit logs (security & compliance).
- Indemnity: cap tied to annual subscription spend; we'd like to see exceptions for IP and gross negligence carved out.
- PO & billing: Helix uses a centralized PO # that we will send; prefer Net-45 payment terms.

Please confirm you can map the private SKU to our Azure merchant account and whether Redwood can accept the PO flow through Marketplace Private Plan (we'll need the Seller Authorization ID for procurement).

Attaching redlines — will await your internal feedback.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Kim
Director, Cloud Procurement
HelixHealth

Forwarding Helix's redlines. Short summary for context:

- Region requirement: East US 2, no cross-border replication without approval.
- Log retention: they ask 365 days; we currently default to 90.
- Indemnity cap/exception: they want carve-outs for IP/gross negligence.
- Billing: PO flow via Azure Marketplace Private Plan; need Seller Authorization ID and confirmation Redwood can accept PO-based invoicing via the marketplace.

Ben/Marissa — can you confirm commercial flexibility and whether we can route the invoice through marketplace?
Irene/Lauren — legal input on residency/indemnity and retention trade-offs?

Thanks,
Hannah

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelixHealth redlines — need legal + billing input

Quick commercial take:

- Data residency: East US 2 is fine from a pricing standpoint; mapping the SKU to Helix's merchant account is an ops task but doable. We may need the customer to accept a small delay on provisioning while we confirm region alignment in Azure.
- Log retention: Offering 365 days by default materially increases storage cost. Suggest compromise: 180 days included, with an upgrade option for 365 at a small recurring fee.
- Indemnity cap: we typically hold cap at 1x ARR. For strategic enterprise deals we can consider exceptions but would need Legal sign-off.
- Billing: Marketplace PO flow is supported in most private plan engagements; need marketplace seller support to confirm invoice routing (we'll include marketplace@microsoft.com on the thread).

If Helix is willing to take the 180/paid upgrade path we can avoid a commercial concession today.

-Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelixHealth redlines — legal thoughts + draft addendum

Team — attaching a draft Data Residency Addendum and my redlines to the commercial terms (DataResidency_Addendum_draft.docx, Legal_Redlines_v1.pdf). Key legal positions:

- Residency language: Accept East US 2 but we need to keep limited operational exceptions for cross-az replication for DR within the same region. Explicitly prohibit copying to other geopolitical regions without consent.
- Log retention: propose compromise of 180 days included; additional retention to be a billable add-on. This balances Helix's need with our cost model.
- Indemnity/IP: we will not accept uncapped IP indemnities. Recommend cap at 1x ARR with carve-outs for willful misconduct and wilful IP infringement (explicit wording in redlines).
- Audit evidence: provide SOC 2 Type II summary and offer a standard security self-attestation; for deeper audits Helix can request engagement with SOC vendor under NDA and cost recovery.

If the customer insists on 365 days or a higher indemnity cap, flag for leadership review.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DataResidency_Addendum_draft.docx (docx, 28KB)]
[Attachment: Legal_Redlines_v1.pdf (pdf, 34KB)]

Jordan
